messages:
alex: Heads up from today's onboarding lab: JS SDK + JSON mode function-calls can hit `Unexpected end of JSON input` when an auth refresh/retry occurs mid-stream.

maria: Yikes. Short repro?

alex: Clone sample-app, run the demo that calls `create_order` with strict schema, then force token expiry during response. If retry overlaps streaming chunks, the validator sees truncated JSON.

jon: Python buffers full message, JS validates incrementally for speed which makes it brittle with retries.

sam: Temporary workshop workaround: set RW_SDK_STREAMING=false or RW_SDK_RETRY=0.

alex: I opened a tiny sample-app PR with client-side buffering to reassemble top-level JSON before validation: https://github.com/redwood-inference/sample-apps/pull/501.

maria: Please file an SDK parity bug and add an e2e that simulates mid-stream auth refresh.

sam: Filed #1630: "JS SDK streaming + retry -> partial-parse errors" with a harness and suggested flag `streamingStrictJson` for opt-in parity.

jobs-bot: deploy pr/501 -> staging started (job 9001)

deploy-bot: deploy job 9001: SUCCESS on staging - https://ci.redwood-inference/internal/jobs/9001/logs

sam: Verified staging. Buffering fix prevents the parse error in the demo. Will follow up to port into SDK and add diagnostics for partial fragments.

alex: Adding a quickstart note to warn new users until SDK patch ships.
